info.title: 🏛️ Tender Verification Platform - Bidder REST & ML AI API Documentation
info.description: Comprehensive REST API specification for the **Bidder Module** of the Tender Management & Verification Platform (SIH 2026). Covers Bidder Authentication (Government Records Verification, Brevo Email OTP, JWT Bearer Tokens, Password Recovery), Profile Management, Cloudinary Compliance Document Uploads, ML Anti-Forgery Inspections (pyHanko Digital Signatures, pyzbar QR verification, Tesseract OCR), Live GST Portal Taxpayer Verification, Pre-Submission CIS Scoring, GFR Rule 173(i) MSE/Startup Waivers, Batch Audits, and RAG Markdown Dossiers.

post.summary: 1. Initiate Bidder Signup & Government Database Verification
post.description: Initiates bidder registration by cross-validating `legalName`, `email`, and `gstNumber` against official government records (`bidder_verification` database table). Upon match, creates a temporary pending session and dispatches a 6-digit verification OTP via Brevo Email Service.

201.description: Signup initiated successfully - temporary registration token created and OTP sent

example.message: Bidder verified successfully against government records! Verification OTP sent to arnav24169006@gmail.com

400.description: Validation failure or mismatch with official government records

example.message: Bidder verification failed: Legal name or GST number does not match official government records.

409.description: Email or GST number already registered

example.message: A bidder with this email or GST number is already registered.

post.summary: 2. Verify Registration OTP & Finalize Permanent Account
post.description: Validates the 6-digit OTP sent to the bidder's email (using either email or tempToken). On successful verification, activates the permanent bidder database record and returns a 24-hour valid JWT Bearer authentication token.

200.description: Registration completed successfully - Permanent account active and JWT token issued

example.message: Registration completed successfully! Bidder account created and verified.
Invalid or expired OTP. Please enter the latest OTP received.

post.description: Generates and dispatches a fresh 6-digit OTP to the registered bidder email address.

example.message: A fresh OTP has been sent to arnav24169006@gmail.com

404.description: Pending registration not found for email

post.description: Authenticates an existing verified bidder with registered email and password, issuing a JWT Bearer token valid for 24 hours.

example.message: Bad credentials: Invalid email or password.

post.description: Validates whether a given token (`JWT Bearer Token` or `tempToken`) is active and valid, returning bidder session details. Accepts token via Authorization header (`Bearer <token>`), request body (`token` or `tempToken`), or query parameter (`?token=...`).

value.message: JWT token is valid and active.
Temporary registration token is valid and active.

get.description: Validates token passed via Authorization header or query parameter (`?token=...` or `?tempToken=...`).
Fetches profile details and verification status of the currently authenticated bidder using the Bearer JWT token.

401.description: Missing or invalid Bearer JWT token

post.description: Verifies that the bidder exists and dispatches a 6-digit password reset OTP to their registered email address.

example.message: Password reset OTP sent to your registered email.

404.description: No registered bidder found with provided email

post.description: Validates the 6-digit OTP sent for password reset and issues a secure single-use reset token (`resetToken`).

200.description: OTP verified successfully - Reset token issued

post.description: Updates the bidder account password using the verified `resetToken`.

example.message: Password reset successfully. You can now login with your new password.

400.description: Invalid or expired reset token, or password requirements not met

post.description: Pre-verifies GSTIN or PAN against ML Taxpayer Intelligence models and live GST portal before registration. Returns filing compliance score, active taxpayer status, and name match check.

example.message: Taxpayer active and in good standing.

get.description: Fetches a complete list of all registered bidders. Protected endpoint requiring Bearer JWT token.
Retrieves the full profile details of a specific bidder by their numeric ID.

put.description: Updates profile information (phone, address, Udyam number, PAN, metadata) for a registered bidder.

example.address: B-44, Tech Zone 4, Greater Noida, UP 201306

delete.description: Deletes the bidder account profile from the database.

post.summary: 16. Upload Compliance Document (Cloudinary + ML Forensic Intake)
post.description: Uploads a compliance certificate (PDF, JPG, PNG) to Cloudinary and performs instant ML anti-forgery analysis. Executes Tesseract OCR, pyHanko cryptographic digital signature verification, pyzbar QR scanning, and NER entity extraction.

file.description: Certificate file (PDF, PNG, JPG) up to 10MB

201.description: Document uploaded, processed, and forensic report persisted

example.rawOcrText: GOVERNMENT OF INDIA - CERTIFICATE OF REGISTRATION UNDER GST ... Legal Name: Arnav Tyagi ... GSTIN: 09ARNAV9012H3Z7 ...

digitalSignatureReport.signer_common_name: Government of India GST Authority CA

400.description: Invalid file format or empty file

get.description: Retrieves all compliance certificates uploaded by the currently authenticated bidder, ordered by most recent upload date.

200.description: List of uploaded documents and analysis findings

get.summary: 18. Get Document Forensic Details by ID
get.description: Retrieves complete forensic metadata, OCR transcript, digital signature audit, and authenticity verdict for a specific uploaded document.

404.description: Document not found or does not belong to authenticated bidder

delete.description: Deletes the compliance document record from the database and permanently removes the asset from Cloudinary storage.

204.description: Document successfully purged from database and Cloudinary (No Content)

post.description: Runs the Python ML Composite Compliance Index (CIS) engine on the bidder's uploaded documents against required tender criteria. Computes score (0.0 to 1.0), detects missing mandatory documents, highlights deficiencies, and forecasts clearance eligibility (`ELIGIBLE_SINGLE_CLICK`, `CONDITIONAL_REVIEW`, `DISQUALIFIED`).

recommendations: All criteria validated. High probability of Single-Click Automated Tender Clearance!
example.summary: Calculated via ML Composite Compliance Index Engine (v2.0.0).

post.summary: 21. Instant Taxpayer Document Scanner (OCR & Live Portal)
post.description: Public forensic scanner. Uploads a PAN card or GST certificate image/PDF, executes high-resolution OCR, repairs optical distortion, extracts identifiers, and executes optional real-time live queries on the GSTN portal.

useLivePortal.description: Whether to perform a live network query to the official GST taxpayer search endpoint

400.description: Document scan failed or file empty

post.summary: 22. Live Taxpayer Identifier Verification (GSTIN or PAN)
post.description: Public direct validation endpoint. Queries the ML taxpayer engine and official live records for a given GSTIN or PAN to confirm active legal status, return filing regularities, and business risk score.

example.message: Taxpayer verified successfully with high filing integrity.

post.summary: 23. Master Autonomous Audit (GFR 173(i) MSE Waivers & ML Verdict)
post.description: Audits all uploaded compliance certificates against tender specifications before official bid submission. Applies General Financial Rules (GFR) Rule 173(i) MSE & Startup exemptions (prior turnover and prior experience waivers), runs Random Forest qualification prediction, and generates an audit report.

example.tender_notice: Tender No. PWD/2026/089: Mandatory PAN, GST, and Udyam MSME Registration required.

mse_waivers_applied.governing_statute: GFR Rule 173(i) & Public Procurement Policy for MSEs Order 2012
